title: Android APK / Firebase misconfiguration
steps: `apktool d app.apk -o out` and `jadx -d out-jadx app.apk`; read `AndroidManifest.xml` for exported components and permissions.
Check Firebase database/storage rules with a read-only request; do not write unless the challenge explicitly allows it.
Trace the auth/flag path in jadx; hook runtime checks with Frida/objection only if static analysis is insufficient.
falsifier: No Firebase config, no exported component, and the backend rejects unauthenticated reads.
